design: A VERY cute small lime-green slime with a rounded jellybean/dumpling silhouette, TWO BIG round dark-brown sparkling cartoon eyes with white highlights, tiny friendly curved smile, small rosy cheek marks, soft pale-green inner glow and a few simple bubbles. NOT angry, NO narrow sinister eyes, NO fangs, NO realistic viscera. The green color identifies its acid nature without making it scary. Idle bouncy breathing and blink on a stable puddle base, hurt comically squeezes eyes shut, attack makes one small rounded pseudopod boop to the right with determined cute expression, dodge flattens and leans back then returns. One connected slime per cell, no detached droplets.
